name: RC-B10-0571/2025 – Recital H
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text: whereas, since 2021, Belarus has systematically instrumentalised migration by directing irregular migrants toward the Lithuanian border as a deliberate destabilisation strategy; whereas, taken together, UAVs and balloon incursions, disinformation campaigns and border pressure constitute a pattern of coordinated hybrid aggression against Lithuania and the EU;
